"""Live check of the new reader through the pipeline's own request path. Not experiment data."""

import json
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\46762\VSCODE\allegoria")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from simulacria.anthropic_io import (  # noqa: E402
    EXTRACTOR,
    UnusableResponse,
    api_key,
    billed_cost,
    post_response,
    request_payload,
    response_text,
    with_schema,
)
from simulacria.measurement.slot_reading import reading_input, validate_reading  # noqa: E402
from simulacria.measurement.source_slots import load_source_slots  # noqa: E402
from simulacria.recursive_plan import reading_format  # noqa: E402

PROBE = ROOT / "data/local/probes/model-probe-edf74b0af9ac"
key = api_key(ROOT)
sources = {s["passage_id"]: s for s in load_source_slots(ROOT / "corpus/law_probe_v1.yaml", ROOT)}
reader = (ROOT / "prompts/read_slots.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
probe = json.loads((PROBE / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
out = ROOT / "data/local/probes" / ("haiku-reader-check-" + uuid4().hex[:12])
out.mkdir(parents=True)

cases = [("source", pid, s["text"]) for pid, s in sources.items()]
cases += [
    (f"allegory-by:{r['model_requested']}", r["label"].split(":", 2)[2], r["text"])
    for r in probe["rows"]
    if r["label"].startswith("transform:allegorize") and r.get("text")
]
opus = {
    (f"allegory-by:{r['writer']}", r["label"].split(":")[-1]): r.get("statuses")
    for r in probe["allegory_readings"]
    if r["model_requested"] == "claude-opus-5"
}

rows, total = [], 0.0
for kind, pid, text in cases:
    slots = sources[pid]["slots"]
    payload = with_schema(
        request_payload(EXTRACTOR, reader, reading_input(text, slots)), reading_format(slots)
    )
    status, raw = post_response(payload, key)
    name = uuid4().hex
    (out / f"{name}.json").write_bytes(raw)
    cost = billed_cost(raw, EXTRACTOR)
    total += cost
    row = {"kind": kind, "passage_id": pid, "http": status, "raw": name, "usd": cost}
    if status == 200:
        try:
            answer, response = response_text(raw, EXTRACTOR)
            row["usage"] = response["usage"]
            got = validate_reading(answer, text, slots)
            row["valid"] = True
            row["statuses"] = {s["slot_id"]: s["status"] for s in got}
        except UnusableResponse as error:
            row.update(valid=False, reason=error.reason)
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            row.update(valid=False, reason=type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)[:160])
    row["opus_statuses"] = opus.get((kind, pid))
    rows.append(row)
    agree = ""
    if row.get("statuses") and row["opus_statuses"]:
        diff = {k: (v, row["opus_statuses"].get(k)) for k, v in row["statuses"].items()
                if v != row["opus_statuses"].get(k)}
        agree = "agrees with Opus" if not diff else f"DIFFERS from Opus (haiku, opus): {diff}"
    present = sum(v == "present" for v in (row.get("statuses") or {}).values())
    print(f"{kind:<28} {pid:<22} http={status} valid={row.get('valid')} "
          f"present={present}/{len(slots)} ${cost:.4f} out={row.get('usage', {}).get('output_tokens')} "
          f"{row.get('reason', '')} {agree}")

(out / "manifest.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "kind": "reader_check",
            "experiment_data": False,
            "at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            "reader": EXTRACTOR,
            "script_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "script": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
            "total_usd": total,
            "rows": rows,
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)
print(f"total ${total:.4f} -> {out}")
